page.overview:
Who is Amanda Ormand?

Amanda Ormand is Frank Ormand's widow. She was presumably married to Ormand for several years prior to his death in a car crash. Homer Simpson visited her house asking for her husband in search of advice for running Ormand's Pretzel Wagon. However, she told Simpson about her husband's regrettable passing. When Homer asked for his executor of the estate instead, Amanda then explained that not only was the executor also dead, but they both died in the same car crash (in fact, both had been in the same car).
